breaking_news.headline: Can smartphones help explain the drop in birth rates?
breaking_news.summary: Are smartphones causing people to have fewer children?  A provocative new working paper explores the persistent drop in birth rates since the iPhone was introduced nearly two decades ago.

breaking_news.headline: Door shuts on some immigrant entrepreneurs as U.S. restricts small-business loans
breaking_news.summary: For decades, immigrants who are legal permanent residents in the U.S. could get loans through the Small Business Administration, a core pillar of small-business lending. Not anymore.

breaking_news.headline: SpaceX IPO makes history as largest ever. Stock gains 19% on first day
breaking_news.summary: The initial public offering from the rocket and AI company raised some $75 billion, making the company one of the biggest in the world — and likely making Elon Musk a trillionaire.

breaking_news.headline: Justice Dept. approves Paramount's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery
breaking_news.summary: The decision paves the way for a proposed $111 billion merger uniting two rival studio giants — Paramount, owner of CBS, and the much larger Warner, which includes HBO and CNN.

breaking_news.headline: Paramount-Warner Brothers merger gets Justice Department approval
breaking_news.summary: The Justice Department closed its investigation into the proposed $110 billion merger of Paramount and Warner Brothers Discovery, saying it found no threat to competition or consumers.

breaking_news.headline: Kennedy Center removes Trump's name from the building
breaking_news.summary: Workers finished removing President Trump's name from the facade of the Kennedy Center early Saturday, hours after a court-ordered Friday deadline to remove references to Trump from the building.

breaking_news.headline: Oil prices drop to cheapest level since early days of Middle East conflict
breaking_news.summary: Oil prices had already fallen quite dramatically on Thursday and Friday in anticipation of a deal. Trump has posted online that the Strait of Hormuz will reopen after the deal is signed this Friday.

breaking_news.headline: How much of an economic boom is the 2026 FIFA World Cup for the U.S. hosting cities?
breaking_news.summary: The FIFA World Cup is thought to bring an economic windfall to the cities and regions where games will be played during four weeks this summer. How true is that?

breaking_news.headline: Australia to probe assault claims by Gaza flotilla activists against Israeli forces
breaking_news.summary: Australian activists claim they were kidnapped, raped and tortured after being detained in May.

breaking_news.headline: Eight dead after US Air Force B-52 bomber crashes in California
breaking_news.summary: The Boeing B-52 Stratofortress has been used by the US military since the 1950s.

breaking_news.headline: VAR official says hand gesture was 'involuntary, subconscious twitch'
breaking_news.summary: Video assistant referee Shaun Evans has denied "intentionally" making a hand gesture "to communicate a message, affiliation, game or belief of any kind" and claimed it was a "an involuntary, subconscious twitch" that he was "unaware" of.

breaking_news.headline: California's Gavin Newsom alleges justice department is investigating his wife and ex-staff
breaking_news.summary: A source familiar with the investigations said they had been ongoing for "roughly a year'".

breaking_news.headline: Married at First Sight Australia allegations 'disturbing', says country's watchdog
breaking_news.summary: The claims also prompted a response from UK media regulator Ofcom, who called them "deeply concerning".

breaking_news.headline: Iran deal presents political nightmare for Netanyahu
breaking_news.summary: Donald Trump's ceasefire agreement with Iran leaves the Israeli PM trapped in a new political and security dilemma.

breaking_news.headline: Trump may release US-Iran deal before Friday, Vance says
breaking_news.summary: The US vice-president says the agreement is "about a page and a half" and "very general", meaning many details will be worked out later.

breaking_news.headline: Anthropic to meet White House over AI tool suspension
breaking_news.summary: The sudden meeting was called after Anthropic had to block users from just-released AI models.

breaking_news.headline: What's happening to UK petrol and diesel prices now the US and Iran have a deal?
breaking_news.summary: When the conflict began on 28 February, fuel costs jumped as the war disrupted the production and transportation of energy across the Middle East.

breaking_news.headline: What is Helium-3 and could we get it from the moon?
breaking_news.summary: Helium-3 is expensive and demand is forecast to soar, so some are planning to mine it on the moon.

breaking_news.headline: Oil prices fall and shares jump after US-Iran deal announced
breaking_news.summary: Under the agreement, the key Strait of Hormuz waterway will be reopened, US President Donald Trump said.

breaking_news.headline: SpaceX IPO raised $10bn more than thought
breaking_news.summary: The company's listing raised $87.5bn, compared with the $75bn it was initially thought.
